text:
Ingrid: Short recap from today's all-hands Q&A on release cadence, oncall, quality bars, and SLAs. Putting answers here.

Lee: Thanks! Quick confirm on cadence?

Ingrid: Major releases: biweekly Tue 09:00 PT. Minor infra patches: weekly Thu. Hotfixes: ad-hoc with rollback playbook. Feature rollouts use canaries + flags.

Matt: Freeze window for runtime/model changes?

Ingrid: 48-hour freeze before the deploy for runtime or serving changes. UI-only work can be gated by flags.

Sofia: Oncall: 2-week rotation, primary + secondary. Ack target 10m, mitigation/rollback attempt within 30m. If hosted SLA impacted, notify CS within 1h.

Emily: Canary numbers and rollback triggers?

Priya: Defaults: 5% for 1h, 25% for 6h, then 100% if green. Monitor eval-quality, token errors, user error-rate, latency p95/p99. Auto-rollback: quality drop >5% on labeled evals, user error-rate >2x baseline, p99 latency +40% or p95 +200ms over baseline. Teams tune per-model.

Lee: Where are playbooks?

devbot: Release playbook: https://redwood.internal/playbooks/release-cadence  Canary policy: https://redwood.internal/platform/canary-policy  Incident runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/incident-response

Matt: Sales asks about SLA credits?

Ingrid: Public SLA summary (hosted) 99.9% monthly uptime; credits pro-rata after confirmed incident. Dedicated/private terms in SOW. Internal sales doc: https://redwood.internal/sla-summary

Emily: Who owns evals/prompt sets?

Priya: Shared: Research owns harness & metrics, Product owns prompt sets/acceptance, Eng+SRE own rollout automation. RACI will be added to playbook.

Lee: Can oncall rollback without PM approval?

Ingrid: Yes for incidents meeting severity thresholds in the runbook. Notify PMs ASAP but do not block rollback.

Ingrid: We'll hold a 45-min office hours next Wed 4pm PT to walk the playbook: https://calendar.internal/event/eng-playbook-qa. Tag me with anything missing and we'll update the doc.
